# Phi Movers

> London removals company: house and flat moves, man and van, office removals, packing, storage and single-item delivery across all 32 London boroughs, plus longer moves across the UK. Based in Dagenham, east London.

Facts in this file come from kit/site-facts.ts and lib/contact.ts. Update it when those change.

## Company
- Trading name: Phi Movers
- Legal entity: Phi Movers Ltd
- Address: 247 Becontree Ave, Dagenham RM8 2UT, United Kingdom
- Area served: all 32 London boroughs and the City of London (Greater London), plus UK moves
- Office hours: 7am–9pm, seven days a week (London time)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +44 7405 793433 (https://wa.me/447405793433)
- Email: info@phimovers.co.uk
- Website: https://www.phimovers.co.uk/
- Quotes: a fixed quote in about one working hour (https://www.phimovers.co.uk/contact#quote)

## Prices
Published hourly van rates, two-hour minimum, billed by the hour after that:
- Small van: £50/hr (boxes and single items)
- Transit van: £55/hr (a sofa or a studio move)
- Luton van: £65/hr (flats and house moves)
- Extra helper: £20/hr
- First 10 miles free, then £1.50 a mile
- Full price guide: https://www.phimovers.co.uk/pricing
